in_hebrew.name: זָכָרִי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: בְּאֵ֖ל הַנִּצָּ֑ב (be el hanitsab) meaning 'in the one who stands before the Lord' - etymology from Hebrew (zakar) meaning 'to remember' or 'to mention', biblical reference in 1 Chronicles 6:13, historical usage in Jewish and Christian traditions, spiritual significance in remembering God's promises, cultural importance in honoring ancestors and patriarchs

in_greek.name: Ζαχαρίας
in_greek.meaning: Ζαχαρίας (Zacharias) meaning 'God has remembered' or 'he remembers'
in_greek.long_meaning: ὁ ἱερεύς (ho hiereus) meaning 'the priest' - etymology from Greek (zacharizein) meaning 'to remember', New Testament reference in Luke 1:5-25, historical usage in early Christian church as a baptismal name, spiritual significance in remembering God's covenant with Israel, cultural context in ancient Greek and Roman traditions

in_latin.name: Zacharia
in_latin.meaning: Zacharia meaning 'God has remembered' or 'he remembers'
